title: Current State: Portfolio and Scenario Analysis
subtitle: How Fiona answers a portfolio-and-scenario question today, before the solution. Pain points in red, cycle times on each step.

gapSummary: Four of the steps are hand work between systems, and they are where the days go: assembling, reconciling, chasing differences, and finding the play.
